spanish: y oiga su padre su voto y su atadura que ató sobre su alma, y calle a ella su padre, y se levantarán todos sus votos, y toda atadura que ató sobre su alma se levantará.

findings.issue: Sequential perfect 3ms (hear; hiphil be silent) is present subjunctive, while the same sequential-perfect class on the vows is future. oiga/calle can read as a wish or command.

notes: Number, person, suffixes, singular/plural vow and bond, and the repeated bind-upon-her-soul clause match the tokens.
